units.source_text: 关于紫姬，源氏公子有所考虑：

en.t: Regarding Lady Murasaki, Prince Genji thought things over:

units.source_text: “这个人是何等身份，世人至今尚未知悉，深恐有人看轻她。

en.t: “The world still does not know what rank this person truly has, and I greatly fear that someone may look down on her.

units.source_text: 不如乘此机会，正式告知她父亲兵部卿亲王吧。”

en.t: It would be better to take this opportunity to formally inform her father, Prince Hyobukyo.”

units.source_text: 便替紫姬举行着裳仪式。

en.t: So he held the mogi coming-of-age ceremony for Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 虽不大事宣扬，但排场特别体面。

en.t: Although he did not make a public display of it, the ceremony was arranged with exceptional dignity.
This was truly done out of sincere devotion.

units.source_text: 然而紫姬竟从此嫌恶了源氏公子。

en.t: Yet from that time on, Lady Murasaki came to detest Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 她想：“年来我万事信赖他，放心地依附他，想不到此人如此卑鄙！”

en.t: She thought, “All these years I trusted him in everything and depended on him without worry, never imagining that he could be so vile!”

units.source_text: 她颇感后悔，正面也不看他一眼。

en.t: She felt deep regret and would not even look him in the face.

units.source_text: 源氏公子向她调笑，她总是板起面孔，表示讨厌。

en.t: When Prince Genji teased her playfully, she always stiffened her face and showed her dislike.

units.source_text: 从前那种天真烂漫的样子，现在完全没有了。

en.t: The innocent brightness she had once shown was now completely gone.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得又是可爱，又是可怜。

en.t: Prince Genji found her both adorable and pitiable.

units.source_text: 他说：“年来我真心疼爱你，现在你如此讨厌我，教我好不伤心！”

en.t: He said, “All these years I have loved you with all my heart; now that you hate me so much, how could I not be heartbroken?”

units.source_text: 岁月匆匆，这一年又过完了。

en.t: The months hurried by, and that year too came to an end.
